source: https://disneyworld.disney.go.com/guest-services/resort-transportation/, cross-checked against general Disney World transportation structure (monorail loop, Skyliner network, EPCOT-area walking/boat, Disney Springs boat) plus a live-status check (2026-08-08) for current disruptions.
note: Disney's real rule: if a resort has monorail/Skyliner/boat/walking access to a park, there's no bus to that same park - buses only run where no direct route exists, or as backup when the primary system is down. 'Primary' below is the direct, no-transfer mode; everything else from that resort is bus. This is real infrastructure, not investment-relevant, but genuinely affects day-to-day trip quality - a bus-only resort can mean 20-45 min each way including wait/loading vs a 5-10 min monorail/Skyliner/walk.
currentDisruptions: Old Key West <-> Disney Springs boat paused since 2026-07-20 for refurbishment (no confirmed resume date as of fetch) - bus substituted meanwhile.
Skyliner scheduled to close entirely for annual refurbishment 2027-01-24 to 2027-01-30 (affects Riviera + 3 non-DVC resorts) - bus substituted during that window.

Bay Lake Tower.notes: Closest DVC resort to Magic Kingdom - walking is genuinely viable, not just the monorail.

primary.EPCOT: monorail (transfer at Ticket and Transportation Center)

Grand Floridian Villas.notes: EPCOT via monorail needs a transfer, not a direct one-seat ride.

primary.EPCOT: monorail (transfer at Ticket and Transportation Center)

Polynesian Villas & Bungalows.notes: Same monorail-loop position as Grand Floridian.

Copper Creek Villas & Cabins.notes: Same Wilderness Lodge boat launch as Boulder Ridge.

Cabins at Fort Wilderness.notes: Internal resort bus/boat loop to reach the Magic Kingdom boat dock or bus depot first - more steps than other Magic Kingdom-area resorts.

BoardWalk Villas.notes: Walking to EPCOT/Hollywood Studios is genuinely fast (10-20 min) - a real practical perk for park-hopping between those two.

Beach Club Villas.notes: Same EPCOT-area walking/boat position as BoardWalk.

Riviera Resort.notes: Skyliner has real weather-related downtime (closes for lightning/high wind) - bus substitutes when that happens. Scheduled to close entirely 2027-01-24 to 2027-01-30 for annual refurbishment.

Animal Kingdom Villas.notes: Bus-only to every park, including Animal Kingdom itself (no walking path despite being on the same property) - the one deluxe WDW resort with no direct/express mode to anywhere.

Saratoga Springs.notes: Bus-only to all 4 theme parks - Disney Springs is the only direct-access destination.

Old Key West Resort.notes: Bus-only to all 4 theme parks. The Disney Springs boat is currently suspended for refurbishment since 2026-07-20 - see currentDisruptions.

Grand Californian Villas.notes: Disneyland Resort, not Walt Disney World - has its own private entrance directly into California Adventure, and Disneyland Park is a short walk. No bus system needed/used at this resort.

Disneyland Hotel Villas.notes: Disneyland Resort - the monorail has a station at this hotel with a stop inside Disneyland Park.

Aulani.notes: Not a Walt Disney World or Disneyland resort - Ko Olina, Oahu, Hawaii. No theme park transport applies at all; this is a standalone beach resort with its own water features. A trip here doesn't combine with WDW/DL parks in the same visit without separately flying to Orlando/Anaheim.

Hilton Head Island Resort.notes: Not near any Disney theme park - South Carolina, ~6-7 hours' drive from Walt Disney World. No park transport applies at all.

Vero Beach.notes: Not near any Disney theme park - Florida's Atlantic coast, ~2-2.5 hours' drive from Walt Disney World. No park transport applies at all.
